_actions.focus-next: cycle focus to the next pane
_actions.focus-up|down|left|right: move focus to the nearest pane in that direction
_actions.kill-pane: close the focused pane (never the last one)
_actions.resize-up|down|left|right: grow/shrink the focused pane in that direction
_actions.split-horizontal: split the focused pane into top/bottom
_actions.split-vertical: split the focused pane into left/right
_actions.swap-next: swap the focused pane with the next pane
_actions.swap-prev: swap the focused pane with the previous pane

_comment: copland keybinds. The leader arms on keydown; the next key selects a binding. Combos are 'Mod+Key' (Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Meta); bare keys match case-insensitively. While the leader is armed, the leader's own modifiers are ignored on the follow-up key, so holding Alt through leader+Arrow works the same as releasing it. Ctrl+Shift+V pastes outside the leader system and is handled in renderer.js, not here. Change the leader here — never in renderer.js.
